title: Run your cohort review over live video
body:
Hold your cohort review as a live video call — right inside Pathment, no external links to juggle.

  • On the Cohort Review page, hit Start meeting. Everyone in your clan gets an instant “Join review” banner on their dashboard.
  • People join as themselves — their Pathment name and profile photo show in the call.
  • When you’re done, the End & score button (or just hanging up) wraps the call and takes you straight to scoring.

The video runs on Pathment’s own server — nothing is recorded or stored, only who attended.

title: Take attendance straight from the review call
body:
Turn a review call into an attendance record with one switch.

  • Flip Track attendance on during a call and anyone who joins is marked present automatically — even people already in the room.
  • Leave it off for a casual/general call and no attendance is recorded.
  • You can always click a name to override.

title: See who spoke up — and credit them
body:
The review call now gives you a feel for who contributed by speaking.

  • Each mentee’s speaking time is estimated during the call.
  • When you end the call, active speakers are pre-checked so you can award a contribution point in one click — and you can tick anyone who helped in chat too.

It’s an estimate to guide you, not a stopwatch — the final call is always yours.

title: Spot brand-new mentees at a glance
body: Mentees who joined in the last 10 days now carry a “New” badge — on the cohort review, your mentee cards and at-risk lists — so you know who’s just getting started and can give them a warmer welcome.

title: Your next task lands the moment you submit
body:
On a roadmap, you no longer wait for your mentor to review before the next step appears.

  • As soon as you submit a roadmap task, the next step is assigned right away — so there’s always something to get on with.
  • If it was the last step, nothing new is assigned; finishing (and moving to a linked roadmap) still happens when your mentor approves.

title: Move a mentee to another clan — no admin needed
body:
Found a mentee who’d thrive with a different mentor? You can now hand them over yourself.

  • Open the mentee’s profile (or their card in Cohort Review) and choose Move to another clan.
  • Pick the clan — you’ll see each one’s lead mentor, co-mentors and how many mentees they already carry — and say why.
  • That clan’s lead mentor gets a notification and accepts or declines. Nothing moves until they say yes.
  • On acceptance the mentee moves with their progress intact, exactly as an admin move would. Requests waiting on you appear at the top of Clan Team.

Co-mentors can do this too — lead mentors can switch it off per person under co-mentor permissions.
